# vMLX 1.6.55

## Changes

- Publish vMLX 1.6.54 updater manifest (`ae9b4ff8`)
- Native MTP: adoption keeps the live engine's sampling policy and depth; one sidecar evidence rule (`b26fe323`)
- Tool calls: presence and schema validation are separate checks (`ca5f517f`)
- changelog: 1.6.55 adoption round-trip, sidecar evidence rule, tool-argument validation contract (`86062a2c`)
- Prefix cache: the terminal durability barrier reports the recorded store outcome, not "persisted" (`e4778289`)
- Surface tool-call drop and schema warnings on every API lane (`d27cbe69`)
- test: re-pin V4b required tool_choice ordering to the catalog-gated predicate (`881c6adf`)
- test: stand in for the bundle-integrity gate in three fake-bundle load tests (`00a9b1eb`)
- docs: changelog entry for tool-call warnings on every API lane (`5426b56b`)
- Tool calls: deliver warnings on the stream's tool-call path; never leak dropped-call markup (`e2f366f6`)
- Block cache: run the periodic global-budget rescan off the terminal barrier (`877f4c22`)
- Block cache: the deferred budget rescan waits for a quiet writer (`11d64f52`)
- docs: changelog entry for the deferred block-cache budget rescan (`9b081b97`)
- Block cache: idle-time budget rescan never starts while a request is in flight (`ca99b67c`)
- docs: changelog wording for the in-flight rule of the deferred rescan (`6506e91a`)
- Block cache: attribute every budget reconcile by phase; rescan only after an eviction (`4eff087c`)
- test: stand in for the bundle-integrity gate in the JANG loader format tests (`3ffd48e2`)
- Block cache: name the schedulers' activity probe (`c33cddb6`)
- Block cache: a failed deferred rescan keeps its debt; continuous-traffic and crossing pins (`65858f42`)
- deps: bound mlx-vlm below 0.6 on macOS (`2a4abc01`)
- MLLM: opt-in prompt token dump for rendered-prompt diffs (`9c7accde`)
- Chat history: replay persisted tool-step reasoning by step rank (`184a6725`)
- docs: changelog entry for the tool-turn reasoning replay fix (`cd1b2fc2`)
- release: freeze 1.6.55 (`0517fe28`)
- test: pin the shared tool-call filter across parser branches and dialect routes (`d7bb4d23`)
